newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian Vilnius Bank bourse's top stock.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian Vilnius Bank bourse's top stock.

text.p: Leading bank Vilnius Bank was the stock exchange's most active stock in 1996 with turnover of 27.2 million litas, the stock exchange said on Monday.
The Vilnius Bank turnover compared with trade of just 2.54 million litas in 1995, the stock exchange said in a statement.
Second-placed in a list of the 10 most active shares was fellow commercial bank Hermis Bank, which showed turnover of 19.9 million litas in 1996 versus 195,000 litas in 1995.
Vilnius Bank has a high degree of foreign ownership and last year launched GDRs, which are quoted in Luxembourg. Hermis is also a highly-rated commercial bank.
Klaipedos Oil had 16.6 million litas of turnover last year vs 980,000 litas in 1995 trade while Panevezhys Sugar turned over 9.2 million litas.
Other active shares included mostly state-owned Lithuanian Gas on 6.5 million litas of trade while Elfa electronics had six million litas of turnover in 1996.
Another popular share, Birzai Milk, took position number eight with trade of 4.96 million litas. Birzai also GDRs in issue and was the first Lithuanian corporate to make a GDR emission.
